principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class's sum method violates the Open/Closed Principle because any new shape added requires modification of the method to handle the new shape's area calculation.
principle_violations.suggestion: Use polymorphism by introducing an interface or abstract class for shapes with a method to calculate the area. Each shape class can then provide its own implementation.
